newsitem.title: USA: Regal Cinemas completes asset purchase.
newsitem.headline: Regal Cinemas completes asset purchase.

text.p: Regal Cinemas Inc said on Tuesday that it completed its previously-announced asset purchase from Magic Cinemas LLC, a privately-owned theater company with operations in New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

In a statement, Regal said it paid about $24.5 million cash to purchase 36 screens at five Magic Cinemas theaters currently in operation, 52 screens under development in four other theaters and a seven-screen addition to an existing theater.
Regal, a theater chain, said it funded the transaction with cash on hand and borrowings available under its credit facility.
